name: Service Studio
description:
Priority requests share a specialist team.

What changes when you cover the break or serve requests in arrival order?

Starting assumptions
• One hour of requests; 15% have higher queue priority.
• Two specialist stages share two staff; one is unavailable during a five-minute break.
• Queue priority does not interrupt work already in service.

Synthetic teaching models. Timings, demand and staffing are illustrative; layout does not add travel time.
